day_shape: 58 items dominated by Iranian Strait of Hormuz messaging (Larijani, IRGC's Mohbbi/Zolghadr, parliamentary committee, Oman shipping-lane talks); Jerusalem Post reports Trump weighing 'victory' declaration; Houthi missile/drone strikes claimed on Saudi Mokha and Aramco Jizan; nothing from UK Parliament, State Dept or IAEA.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz posture hardens
threads.summary: Iranian officials including Expediency Council head Larijani, IRGC spokesman Mohbbi, deputy speaker Hajibabaei and commander Zolghadr said the Strait will not return to previous conditions until US conditions are met, and parliament's national security committee approved a strategic Hormuz plan. Iran said a deal with Oman on new shipping lanes was in final stages, while Jerusalem Post reported Trump was weighing declaring victory with Hormuz reopening as the key condition.

threads.label: Houthi strikes claimed on Saudi targets
threads.summary: Defa Press reported Ansarallah fired more than 20 missiles at Saudi coalition positions around Mokha and Taiz, claimed heavy Saudi officer casualties, and said a drone struck the Aramco refinery in Jizan. IRIB cited CNN noting the attacks came days after a Turkey–Saudi–Pakistan security agreement, and an Iraqi Sadiqoun parliamentary bloc called for a UN Security Council complaint against Riyadh.

threads.label: Pezeshkian–Khamenei meeting and unity messaging
threads.summary: Khamenei's office and Defa Press reported Pezeshkian met the Supreme Leader at the start of his third presidential year to discuss livelihood, the 'third imposed war' and military developments, with Interior Minister Moumeni and Larijani urging national cohesion. Khamenei's office separately said neighbouring countries must clarify their stance on those attacking Iran.

threads.label: Domestic economic and social strain
threads.summary: Iran International reported Tehran average advertised rent above 720 million rials — roughly three times many workers' monthly pay — and Iranians cutting medical treatment as drug shortages and prices rise. IRIB reported the Tehran stock index up 39,624 points to 5,559,000 and Pezeshkian arguing investment in new technologies would blunt sanctions.

threads.label: Lebanon, Gaza and diaspora files
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post flagged a proposed US Senate bill providing $200 million annually to the Lebanese Armed Forces and Internal Security Forces to disarm Hezbollah, and reported the UK Charity Commission opening an investigation into Al-Khair Foundation over alleged Hamas links. IRIB carried Hamas's response to Netanyahu's opposition to the Gaza Peace Council proposal, with Basem Naim urging mediators and Washington to press Israel on the roadmap.
